name: The World Whispers
text:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

---
Your waking world tells you about the unseen creatures it holds. You seek in your waking world. If you succeed or critically succeed against a creature that was undetected by you, you Point Out the creature to any allies in your waking world. When you Point Out the creatures in this way, the action does not have the visual or manipulate traits, but still requires your allies to be able to hear and understand you.
